cast: Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence, Nick Castle
syn: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night, Michael Myers escapes from a psychiatric hospital and returns to the quiet town of Haddonfield.

cast: Kurt Russell, Wilford Brimley, Keith David
syn: At an American research station in Antarctica, twelve men take in a sled dog that has escaped from a Norwegian camp. What follows it inside can look like any one of them.

cast: Jessica Harper, Stefania Casini, Alida Valli
syn: An American ballet student arrives at a prestigious dance academy in Freiburg on a stormy night, as a series of brutal murders begins.

cast: Edward Woodward, Christopher Lee, Britt Ekland
syn: A devout police sergeant flies to a remote Scottish island to look for a missing girl and finds a community that would rather he didn't.

cast: Adrienne Barbeau, Jamie Lee Curtis, Tom Atkins
syn: On the night of its centenary, a glowing fog rolls in over the coastal town of Antonio Bay, carrying something that wants the town back.

cast: Heather Langenkamp, Johnny Depp, Robert Englund
syn: Teenagers on one suburban street share the same nightmare about a burned man with a bladed glove, and what happens in the dream happens in bed.

cast: Bruce Campbell, Ellen Sandweiss, Betsy Baker
syn: Five friends spend a weekend in a cabin in the Tennessee woods and play a tape recording they should have left alone.

cast: Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher
syn: Two graduates share a car ride to New York and disagree about whether men and women can ever just be friends. It takes them twelve years to settle it.

cast: Cher, Nicolas Cage, Olympia Dukakis
syn: A widowed Brooklyn bookkeeper agrees to marry a safe man, then falls for his estranged, one-handed brother under a very large moon.

cast: John Cusack, Ione Skye, John Mahoney
syn: An aimless kickboxing fan asks out the class valedictorian the summer before she leaves for England.

cast: Cary Elwes, Robin Wright, Mandy Patinkin
syn: A grandfather reads his sick grandson a story about a farm girl, a pirate, a giant, a swordsman and a very determined prince.

cast: David Bowie, Jennifer Connelly
syn: A teenager wishes her baby brother away to the Goblin King and has thirteen hours to cross his maze and take him back.

cast: Tom Cruise, Mia Sara, Tim Curry
syn: A forest boy must stop the Lord of Darkness from killing the last unicorns and plunging the world into endless winter.

cast: Nigel Terry, Helen Mirren, Nicol Williamson
syn: The legend of King Arthur from the sword in the stone to the last battle, played in green light and full plate armour.

cast: Mitsuo Iwata, Nozomu Sasaki
syn: In Neo-Tokyo, 2019, a biker gang member gains psychic powers after a government experiment, and his best friend is the only one who might stop him.

cast: Noriko Hidaka, Chika Sakamoto
syn: Two sisters move to the countryside to be near their sick mother and discover the forest spirits living nearby.

cast: Mako Hyodo, Jinpachi Nezu
syn: In a drowned, empty city, a girl guards a large egg and meets a soldier who carries a cross-shaped weapon. Almost no one speaks.

cast: Kyle MacLachlan, Sheryl Lee, Michael Ontkean
syn: The body of homecoming queen Laura Palmer washes up on a riverbank, and FBI Special Agent Dale Cooper arrives in a logging town full of secrets.

cast: John Kassir
syn: The Crypt Keeper introduces a new tale of greed and grisly comeuppance every week, adapted from the EC Comics of the 1950s.

cast: David Duchovny, Gillian Anderson
syn: Two FBI agents, one a believer and one a sceptic, investigate the cases the Bureau would rather file away.

cast: Koichi Yamadera, Megumi Hayashibara
syn: In 2071, a crew of broke bounty hunters chase small-time criminals across the solar system aboard a fishing trawler called the Bebop.
Ripley returns to the moon where her crew found the alien, this time with a unit of Colonial Marines.
Three discredited parapsychologists start a ghost removal business in New York, just in time for a very large problem.
A schoolgirl and six friends visit her aunt's country house for the summer holidays. The house is hungry.
A composer grieving his family rents a Seattle mansion and hears a child's ball bouncing down the stairs.
A spy returns home to West Berlin to find his wife wants a divorce, and that the reason is not another man.
A young woman searches for her missing father in a California seaside town where the locals gather on the beach to watch the moon.
A woman inherits a Louisiana hotel built over one of the seven gates of hell.
A teenager sees the local undertaker lift a full coffin on his own and starts asking questions.
Two Valley girls survive the comet that turned everyone else to red dust, and go shopping.
A space shuttle finds three bodies in suspended animation inside Halley's Comet and brings them back to London.
A suburban family's youngest daughter starts talking to the television, and the television starts answering.
A writer takes a winter caretaker job at a remote mountain hotel with his wife and son. The hotel has other guests.
A man solves a puzzle box and opens a door to beings who do not distinguish pain from pleasure.
A scientist tests his teleportation pods on himself without noticing the housefly that came along.
A cable TV programmer looking for edgier content picks up a pirate signal that broadcasts something real.
A New York produce wholesaler falls for a woman who turns out to be a mermaid on a six-day visit.
A small-town fire chief with a very long nose helps a tongue-tied firefighter woo the astronomer they both love.
A Staten Island secretary takes over her boss's deal while the boss is laid up with a broken leg.
A twelve-year-old wishes to be big and wakes up as a grown man with a job at a toy company.
A record-store girl from the wrong side of town is asked out by a rich boy, and her best friend takes it badly.
A bullied boy hides in a school attic with a stolen book and finds the story reading him back.
A farmer with dreams of sorcery is chosen to carry a baby across a kingdom hunting for her.
A schoolboy falls in with six dwarves who have stolen the Supreme Being's map of the holes in time.
A knight who is a wolf by night and a woman who is a hawk by day are kept apart by a bishop's curse.

t: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
syn: A princess of a small valley tries to stop two kingdoms from waking the giant insects of a toxic jungle.
Two children try to survive on their own in Kobe in the last months of the Second World War.
A mining boy and a girl who fell from the sky race pirates and the army to a floating city.
In a far future ruled by vampire lords, a half-human hunter takes a job protecting a farm girl.
A bankrupt former model and a wisecracking detective run a Los Angeles agency and argue about everything, including each other.
Two undercover detectives work the drug trade in pastel-coloured Miami, set to the pop charts of the week.
